::: {#def-prior-predictive}
#### Prior predictive distribution

The **prior predictive distribution** of the data $\vY$
is the distribution of $\vY$ implied by the [prior](#def-prior) $\p(\param)$ and the model $\p(\vy \mid \param)$,
before any data are observed
[@gelman2013bda, Section 1.3, p. 7, eq. 1.3]:

$$
\p(\vy) = \int \p(\vy \mid \param)\, \p(\param)\, d\param.
$$
:::
